name: Outline Pursuits
summary: Gaze-assisted selection of occluded objects: outlines of candidate objects move, and the user follows the intended one with the eyes.
howItWorks: Each candidate's outline is traced by a moving stimulus; the system selects the object whose motion the user's eyes follow (smooth pursuit), even if it is partly hidden.
